headline: ‘Hot money’ outflows worsen as investors dump gov’t securities
summary: Foreign investors returned to the Philippine stock market in September but kept selling government securities. Foreign portfolio investment outflows exceeded inflows by $489 million, the widest net outflow in five years, per BSP data.
why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippines' central bank and publishes foreign portfolio investment data. Sustained foreign outflows can pressure the peso and local bond yields.
